Name: Pixel art edit of DCBurger's Portraits
Author: JoshuaHQ
Description:
This edit was before a time the HD version was released. If you have interested in HD portraits, please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]the original mod page[/url]. They are absolutely stunning!


I edit the no glasses version of Maru too, but on Harvey, I lost my Power and only edit his default Portrait.

Install: Extract the xnb files from the zip in your "Stardew Valley/Content/Portraits" folder and override the old files (maybe you want to backup the old portraits first, but this is up to you)
To use Maru without glasses, go to the folder, rename  "Maru.xnb" and "Maru_Hospital.xnb" to something else and give the name to "Maru(no glasses).xnb" and "Maru_Hospital(no glasses).xnb"



Credits to the original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portraits[/url]

[quote]"You can not modify or use the assets contained in my files. Except for the mods that already have been edited. (before April 4,
2017)"[/quote]

(When I read the updated permissions I thought I simply don't touch this mod, so the "last edited at" timestamp stay prior to the April 4,
2017. Seriously, I never thought someone would use an outdated quote from a modified version as "evidence" to try to bypass the current permission settings from the original mod. That's not how it works. Everyone who did that, please be ashamed, thank you.)


Like most other modders, I take the effort mostly for selfish reasons. But if someone enjoys my effort, I would be happy  : )
